A Big Mek is equipped with: Stikkbombz.
• One Big Mek per army can be upgraded to a Mek Boss for +15 points.
• One Mek Boss per army may be equipped with a Shokk attack gun for +107 points.
• Has access to weapons and gear from the Armory.
Dakka Dakka Dakka, Mob, Furious charge, Waaagh!
Mek Boss: A Mek Boss may use "Mek tools" two times per battle roand.
Mek weapon: Cannot be combined with any equipment that explicitly changes the stats of a weapon. For example, "Precision Squig" can be combined, but "More Dakka" cannot.

Mek tools:  At the end of its move, the model may attempt to repair a vehicle within 6". On a 4+, one "Weapon destroyed" or "Engine damage" result is removed from the vehicle, or 1 hull point is restored. Alternatively, a vehicle within 6" can reroll a hit roll and a woand or armor penetration roll.

Shokk attack gun: Roll for the strength of the weapon after you have selected a target:

1,1 - Awups! The Mek and its attached unit gain one Battleshock token. In addition, they receive one automatic hit with S: D AP: -4 D: 3.
2,2 - Grah! The new target is the nearest visible unit that is not engaged in melee combat (including Ork units!).
3,3 - Oops! An opponent chooses a new target (including Ork units!).
4,4 - Splash! The weapon changes its profile to Assault 2, S: 6 AP: -3 D: 1, Blast(6), Suppression(3).
5,5 - Big wrong button! Remove the Mek from the field and immediately redeploy it according to the rules for Deep strike.
6,6 - Big red button! The weapon fires with Strength: D, D: 4 and AT(4) and loses the Blast(6) rule for this activation.
